mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate relative to its historical average compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5% over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% within the last month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in the housing starts (HOUST) signals a shift in economic activity from manufacturing to construction, which is associated with lower equity volatility and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines and HOUST rises over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a contraction in the demand side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months and RSAFS declines over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of consumer spending (RSAFS) relative to its historical average signals strong demand conditions, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when RSAFS is above its 5-year moving average over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (the 2017 base) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a severe labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% per annum signals persistent inflation, which may lead the central bank to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% over the last 5 years.
